narrative:
Material PL3__M0A903F5 exhibits lumpy demand with a mean daily consumption of 16,105 units 
and coefficient of variation of 30.55%. Lead time analysis shows stable supplier performance 
with mean lead time of 5.63 days.

The recommended inventory policy achieves a 95% service level with:
- Safety stock: 27,178 units (vs. SAP 68,113 units)
- Order quantity: 280,828 units (vs. SAP 116,765 units)
- Reorder point: 117,916 units

This optimization reduces total annual inventory costs by $1,934.90 (47.4%), 
from $4,079.07 to $2,144.17.

The dominant source of variability is lead time variability (50.1%), 
suggesting management focus should prioritize supplier reliability.
warnings: Storage capacity constraint is binding. Order quantity reduced from EOQ.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Classical inventory model appropriate for lumpy demand pattern with stable lead times.
